name: the-listening-tree
description: The Listening Tree — Elderly Companion Chatbot (Capacitor Mobile App)

scripts.test:integration: SKIP_ENV_LOCAL=1 DATABASE_URL="postgresql://$(whoami)@127.0.0.1:5432/listening_tree_e2e?sslmode=disable" SUPABASE_POOLER_URL= POSTGRES_POOLER_URL= DATABASE_POOLER_URL= RUN_LIVE_DB=1 PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/integration
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci:python: python -m compileall -q run.py api scripts && npm run test:backend
scripts.ci:mobile: npx cap doctor && ( [ -d android ] || npx cap add android ) && npx cap sync android
scripts.ci:mobile:ios: ( [ -d ios ] || npx cap add ios ) && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init 'The Listening Tree' com.listeningtree.app --web-dir www
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run cap:sync && npm run cap:open:ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run cap:sync && npm run cap:open:android
scripts.build-and-sync: npm run cap:sync && npx cap copy ios && npx cap copy android

author: The Listening Tree Team
